assumptions: Each initial task is estimated at exactly 1 simulated work day as per teaching granularity instructions.
Resource capacity is 1 unit per day for both backend and frontend.
Tasks are assigned to resources based on logical division of labor, but any assignment respecting the 1-day duration and resource ID validity is acceptable.
Integration testing (Task 6) is executed by the Frontend resource acting as the test orchestrator/user-acceptance simulator.
Tasks follow a strict linear dependency chain 1->2->3->4->5, preventing parallel execution of these core modules.
Each task consumes exactly 1 simulated workday of dedicated resource time.
Resource costs are 80,000 cents/day for Backend and 60,000 cents/day for Frontend.

Parallelism is not utilized for the main chain due to strict predecessor constraints; however, if separate resources handle distinct tasks in the chain (e.g., FE for 1, BE for 2), the timeline extends as resources are bottlenecked or idle.

objectives: Deliver a fully functional Campus Event Ticketing simulation platform covering publishing, registration, payment sandbox, e-ticket generation, and online validation.
success_criteria: All six initial tasks completed within estimated timeframes using available backend and frontend resources.

constraints: Scope is fixed at exactly six items; no refunds or offline ticketing in initial release.
Each initial task estimated at 1 simulated workday.
Resources: Backend (capacity 1, cost 80k/day) and Frontend (capacity 1, cost 60k/day).
CR-01 and CR-02 add 1 day each, using new IDs and existing resources, without modifying started/completed tasks.
Simulation engine executes tests; regression fixes required if final test fails.

requirements: REQ-01 活动发布: 支持前端展示和后端存储活动信息(标题、时间、地点、名额)，验收标准为能在列表页正确显示活动详情。
REQ-02 报名与名额管理: 用户提交报名请求时，系统需校验剩余名额并锁定或记录报名数据，验收标准为并发报名不超过总名额限制。
REQ-03 支付沙箱: 集成模拟支付接口，不产生真实资金流转，仅返回成功/失败状态码，验收标准为支付流程完成且状态更新无误。
REQ-04 电子票生成: 基于有效订单生成包含唯一标识符的电子票据数据，验收标准为生成的Ticket ID全局唯一且可被核销系统识别。
REQ-05 在线核销: 提供核销接口，接收Ticket ID后验证有效性并将其标记为已使用，验收标准为有效票一次性通过，无效/重复票被拒绝。
REQ-06 联调验收: 整合上述所有模块进行端到端全流程测试(从发布到核销)，验收标准为全流程无阻塞通过，且处理CR-01/CR-02变更前的稳定性检查。

cases: Case-1: Verify Activity Publishing - Ensure frontend displays activity list with correct details (Title, Time, Location, Capacity) and backend stores data correctly.
Case-2: Verify Registration & Quota - Test concurrent registration requests to ensure system validates remaining quota and does not exceed total capacity.
Case-3: Verify Payment Sandbox - Confirm simulated payment interface returns success/failure codes without real financial transactions.
Case-4: Verify E-Ticket Generation - Validate that generated ticket IDs are globally unique and recognizable by the validation system.
Case-5: Verify Online Validation - Test valid tickets pass once; verify invalid or duplicate tickets are rejected.
Case-6: Verify Integration End-to-End - Execute full flow from Publish -> Register -> Pay -> Generate -> Validate; perform stability check pre-CR.
